meta.requirement: Explore Windrise (20%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Bloody Moon
start.text:
''The great tree at Windrise is quiet today, its leaves barely stirring. Near the base of the hill, half-hidden by the tall grass, an old woman stands completely still, her head tilted toward the sky. She is not looking at anything visible. The afternoon is clear and cloudless.''

''As you pass, she speaks without turning.''

Old Woman: You feel it too, don't you. ''Not a question.'' Something in the air. Like the world holding its breath.

what_r_u_talkn.text:
''She turns. Her eyes are pale and sharp, and they move over you in a way that feels like measurement.''

Old Woman: The Blood Moon. ''her voice drops, unhurried, like she has said this before and knows exactly how it lands'' It is coming. Not tonight, perhaps not for a week. But soon.

''She looks back at the sky.''

Old Woman: When it rises, the land will not be what it was. Things that sleep will wake. Things that stand will fall. ''a pause'' I have seen it before. I know what it costs.

dont_feel_anthn.text:
Old Woman: ''a thin, patient smile'' You will.

''She tilts her head at the sky.''

Old Woman: The Blood Moon is coming. It does not ask for your belief first. When it rises, the land will not be what it was. Things that sleep will wake. Things that stand will fall. ''flatly'' I have seen it before. I know what it costs.

What_kind_of_catastrophe.text:
Old Woman: ''still watching the sky'' Sickness. Storms. Creatures that come out of the dark with more hunger than reason. The last time, three villages burned before the moon passed. The time before that...

''She trails off, shaking her head slowly.''

Old Woman: The point is not the details. The point is that it is coming, and those who are not prepared will feel it badly.

''She finally looks at you again.''

Old Woman: I have spent thirty years learning what preparations matter. I can tell you exactly what to do.

''She pauses.''

Old Woman: Two hundred Silver.

paid.title: Blood Price Paid
paid.text:
''You count out two hundred Silver and hold it out. She takes it without looking at your face, folding the coins into a cloth pouch tucked somewhere inside her coat with the practiced ease of someone who has done this many times.''

Old Woman: ''softly'' Good. That is good.

''She turns and walks away down the slope without another word. No instructions. No further warnings. No explanation of what the preparation is supposed to involve.''

''After a moment you are simply standing alone at Windrise, listening to the grass.''

''The sky looks exactly the same as before.''

refuse.title: Left Her to Wander
refuse.text:
''She looks at you for a long moment. Her expression does not change.''

Old Woman: ''quietly'' That is your choice to make.

''She turns and walks away down the hill, unhurried, as though the conversation ended exactly where she expected it to. Within a minute she is gone, lost somewhere in the long grass below the tree.''

''You stand there a moment longer, looking at the empty sky.''

''Nothing happens.''
